DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所の相談で住んでいる人数を二人と言いましたが、一人は週末に泊まる友人でした。訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 週末宿泊友人を住人数に数え二人と誤回答した訂正を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: When discussing my address, I said two people lived there, but one was a friend staying for the weekend. I would like to correct that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to correct your mistaken answer of two residents, which counted a friend staying for the weekend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 普段そこで暮らしている方はどなたですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私一人です。友人は自分の家があり、先週末だけ泊まりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 常住本人一人で友人別宅先週末宿泊と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Just me. My friend has their own home and only stayed last weekend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are the only permanent resident and your friend has another home and stayed last weekend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宿泊した方と居住の申告を混ぜず、ご本人の状況を担当へ説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please explain your own circumstances to the person in charge, keeping an overnight guest separate from a declaration of residence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 申請の人数を勝手に決め直すのでなく、先ほど二人と答えた理由を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 制度人数を自己断定せず二人回答の理由を担当へ伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than deciding the number for the application myself, I will explain why I answered two earlier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain to the person in charge why you answered two, without deciding the number under the rules yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。住所手続きの取扱いは担当が確認します。友人の転居を申し出ているのではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. The person in charge will check how the address procedure should be handled. You are not reporting a change of address for your friend, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうです。友人の住所を移したいわけではありません。私の暮らす状況を正しく伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人転居申告でなく本人生活状況正確説明希望と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Correct. I do not want to change my friend's address. I want to describe my own living circumstances accurately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you are not reporting your friend's move and want to explain your own living circumstances accurately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように伺って担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that on and connect you with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人一人が普段暮らし、友人は先週末の宿泊だけだと分けて訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 常住本人一人と一時宿泊友人を分け訂正すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will correct it by distinguishing between me, the sole usual resident, and my friend, who only stayed last weekend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will correct the information by distinguishing yourself as the sole permanent resident from your friend as a temporary guest. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。住所担当へご案内します。ご説明ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the address desk. Thank you for explaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約を取り消す電話が途中で切れました。取消しが終わったか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 取消電話途中断で予約取消成立可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The call I made to cancel my appointment was cut off. I would like to check whether the cancellation went through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your appointment was successfully canceled after the cancellation call was cut off. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取消し完了の案内は聞きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you hear confirmation that the cancellation was complete?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 聞いていません。名前を伝えた後に切れて、予約日時をまだ言っていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名伝達後切断で日時未伝達完了案内未受領と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. The call ended after I gave my name, before I had given the appointment date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the call ended after you gave your name, that you had not given the date and time, and that you received no completion confirmation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の予約を担当が確認します。予約票はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check your current booking. Do you have your appointment slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。電話しただけで取消済みとは思わず、票の日時を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元予約票を示し発信だけで取消完了とみなさないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will show the date and time on the slip, without assuming it was canceled just because I called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the original appointment slip and say that merely making the call does not mean the cancellation was completed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認します。ご希望は取消しですか、それとも日時の変更ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check. Do you want to cancel, or change the date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 取消しです。別の日はまだ決まらないので、変更予約も取ったとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 取消希望で代替日未定・変更予約成立ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Cancel. I have not decided on another date, so I will not say I have made a rescheduled booking either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to cancel, have no alternative date yet, and have not secured a rescheduled appointment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が受付結果をご案内します。最後まで内容を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will tell you the result. Please confirm the details through to the end.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の予約状態を聞き、取消し希望を伝えて、完了の返事を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在予約確認後取消希望を伝え受付完了返答確認を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask about the original booking's status, request cancellation, and confirm the reply that it is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will check the current booking, request cancellation, and confirm the response that processing is complete. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。予約担当へおつなぎします。票をお手元にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will connect you with the booking desk. Please keep your slip at hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご用件ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 拾った時計を届けに来ました。この用紙の選択欄は、全部に丸を付ければよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得時計提出時の選択欄全て丸付け可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have come to hand in a watch I found. Should I circle every option on this form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should circle all the options when handing in a found watch. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 選択する内容をご説明します。まず、どこで拾った時計か教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will explain the options. First, please tell me where you found the watch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 公園のベンチの下です。用紙は難しいので、同意と書いてある所全部に丸を付けようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 公園ベンチ下拾得と同意欄一律選択を考えた事情を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Under a park bench. The form is difficult, so I was thinking of circling everything marked 'agree.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you found it under a park bench and why you considered selecting all the consent options. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 全て同じ意味ではありません。拾得者の意向に関する欄を一つずつ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: They do not all mean the same thing. I will explain the sections concerning the finder's wishes one at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 説明を聞くまで丸は付けません。自分の希望を選ぶ所なのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明前未選択で本人意向を選ぶ欄か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not circle anything until I hear the explanation. I would like to know whether these sections are for choosing what I want.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will make no selection before the explanation and ask whether the sections let you indicate your own wishes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。希望や確認事項を分けて案内します。分からなければ聞き返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will explain your preferences and the items requiring confirmation separately. Please ask again if you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この欄はどういう希望を尋ねているか、短い言葉で説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象欄の希望内容を短い表現で説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you explain in a few simple words what preference this section is asking about?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a brief explanation of the preference asked about in the section concerned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が具体的にご説明します。理解できないまま署名する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain the specifics. You do not need to sign without understanding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時計は届けて、欄の説明を聞いてから自分の意向を書きます。全部に一律で丸を付けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 拾得物を提出し理解後本人意向記入で一律選択しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hand in the watch and write my wishes after hearing the explanation of the sections. I will not circle everything indiscriminately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand in the found item and enter your own wishes after understanding the explanation, without selecting everything indiscriminately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。順番にご説明します。お届けありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will explain each section in turn. Thank you for handing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この封筒がポストに入らず持ってきました。強く押したら端が少し破れたので、このまま出せるか見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ポストへ入らなかった厚い封筒の端が破れたため差出し可能か確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This envelope would not fit into the postbox, so I brought it here. Pushing hard tore the edge a little, and I would like you to check whether I can send it like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can mail the thick envelope whose edge tore when it would not fit into the postbox. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだポストへ完全には入れていませんね。中身は外へ出ていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not put it completely into the postbox yet, correct? Have any contents come out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入らなかったので持ち帰りました。冊子が入っていて、中身は全部ありますが角が少し見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未投函で冊子は全て残っているが角が外へ見えると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It would not fit, so I took it home. There is a booklet inside, and all the contents are there, but a corner is showing a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it has not been posted and the entire booklet is still there, but a corner is visible outside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 包装の状態を確認します。中身が出ない形へ直してから差し出す必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the packaging. You need to repair it so the contents cannot come out before posting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 端を押し込むのはやめます。紙が引っ掛かるので、大きい封筒へ入れ替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無理な押込みをやめ引掛かる包装を大きい封筒へ替えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will stop pushing the edge in. The paper catches, so I would like to transfer it to a larger envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will stop forcing it in and want to replace the packaging that catches with a larger envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新しい封筒へ移す時に宛先も書き直してください。重さや厚さが変わったら料金も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please rewrite the address when transferring it to the new envelope. We will also check the postage if the weight or thickness changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宛先のメモを持っています。古い切手を新しい封筒へ自分で剥がして貼ってよいかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛先メモを持ち古い切手を剥がして新封筒へ移せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a note of the address. I would also like to ask whether I may peel off the old stamps myself and put them on the new envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have the address noted down and ask whether you can peel off the old stamps and transfer them to the new envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切手の状態を見て取扱いをご案内しますので、剥がす前にこちらへ見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will look at the stamps and explain how to handle them, so please show them to us before peeling them off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 切手は触らず見てもらい、冊子を新しい封筒で包み直します。料金を確認して窓口から差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切手の確認を受けて包装と料金を整え窓口で差し出すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave the stamps untouched for you to check and repackage the booklet in a new envelope. I will confirm the postage and send it at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will have the stamps checked, sort out the packaging and postage, and send it at the counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず封筒と切手を拝見します。お持ちいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First, let me look at the envelope and stamps. Thank you for bringing them in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面の文字が読みにくいです。残高を声で聞きたいですが、周りに聞こえる大声では困ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残高画面読みにくく声希望だが周囲へ大声公開は困ると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The text on the screen is hard to read. I would like to hear my balance spoken, but it would be a problem if it were said loudly enough for people around me to hear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the balance screen is hard to read and you want spoken assistance, but do not want it announced loudly to people around you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認の方法と場所を担当へ相談できます。ご自身で読める表示の大きさはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can discuss the method and location for checking it with the person in charge. Is there a text size you can read yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きい文字なら読みやすいです。ここで全員に聞こえるように金額を言ってほしいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大文字なら可で全員向け金額読み上げ希望ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Large print is easier to read. I am not asking you to say the amount here so everyone can hear it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that large text works for you and you are not asking for the amount to be read out for everyone to hear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望を伺いました。対応できる表示や個別の案内方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I understand your wishes. We will check the display options and ways of helping you individually.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 残高を隠さなくてよいとは考えず、読める方法を担当と選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残高非秘匿とせず担当と可読方法選択を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not consider my balance something that need not be kept private. I would like to choose a way I can read it with the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to choose a readable method with the person in charge while keeping your balance private. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認の手続きも担当が案内します。暗証番号を口頭で伝える必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will also explain the verification procedure. You do not need to say your PIN aloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号は話しません。本人確認の方法と、静かに説明を聞ける場所を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 暗証番号非開示で本人確認と静かな説明場所を照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not say the number. I will ask about identity verification and somewhere I can listen to the explanation quietly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not disclose your PIN and ask about identity verification and a quiet place for an explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。利用できる場所があるかを確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will check whether a suitable place is available and guide you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 文字の読みやすさと周囲への聞こえ方を伝え、個別の残高確認方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 文字可読性と周囲聴取懸念を示し個別残高確認を相談すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain the difficulty reading the text and my concern about others hearing, and discuss an individual way of checking my balance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will explain text readability and concern about others overhearing, and discuss checking your balance individually. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。窓口担当へご希望を伝えます。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will pass your wishes to the counter staff. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 価格を家で比べたいので、棚の紙を持って帰ろうとしました。これを外してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 価格比較のため棚値札持帰り用取外し可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wanted to take the paper from the shelf home to compare prices there. May I remove it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may remove a shelf price label to take home for comparing prices. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 棚の値札は外さないでください。どの商品を比較したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not remove the shelf price labels. Which products would you like to compare?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 洗剤の大きい袋と小さい袋です。紙はまだ棚に付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大小洗剤比較で値札まだ設置と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The large and small bags of detergent. The paper is still attached to the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to compare large and small detergent bags and that the price label is still in place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品名と容量、表示価格をご自身のメモへ写して確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can copy the product name, quantity and displayed price into your own notes to compare them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 値札を持ち帰らず、どの容量の値段か一緒に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 札未持出しで価格と容量対応を本人メモに記すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not take the price label home. I will also write down which quantity each price is for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave the label and record the price with its corresponding quantity in your own notes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 割引条件がある表示なら、その条件も分けて記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If a displayed discount has conditions, please record those conditions separately too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通常価格と会員価格を別に書きます。会員ではないので通常の方で比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通常会員価格を分け非会員通常価格で比較すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write the regular and member prices separately. I am not a member, so I will compare the regular prices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you will separate regular and member prices and, as a nonmember, compare regular prices. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。購入時にはその時点の表示も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When you make a purchase, please also check the prices displayed at that time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 棚の紙を外さず容量と通常価格をメモします。後日買う時は表示を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札残置・容量通常価格記録・後日購入時表示再確認を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave the shelf label attached and note the quantity and regular price. If I buy later, I will check the display again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will leave the label, record the quantity and regular price, and recheck the display when purchasing later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。商品の場所をご案内します。ご確認ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will show you where the products are. Thank you for checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨が強いので屋根の下へ行きたいです。あの小屋は公園の休憩所でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 強雨で柵外小屋が公園休憩所かを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is raining heavily, so I would like to get under a roof. Is that hut a park rest area?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the hut beyond the fence is a park rest area because it is raining heavily. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所を確認します。どの小屋を指していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check the location. Which hut do you mean?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 柵の向こうの物置のような建物です。公園の案内表示は見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 柵向こう物置様建物で公園表示未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The building that looks like a storage shed on the other side of the fence. I cannot see any park signs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is the shedlike building beyond the fence and you have not confirmed any park signage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 公園の利用場所と確認できない建物を分けましょう。柵を越えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us distinguish park facilities you may use from a building whose status is unconfirmed. Please do not cross the fence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 屋根があるだけで入ってよいと思わず、ここで案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 屋根存在を入場許可とせず柵越えせず案内を聞くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume I may enter just because it has a roof. I will listen to the guidance here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that a roof does not mean permission to enter, and that you will stay this side of the fence and listen to guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる休憩場所を担当が確認します。ご一緒の方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check which rest areas are available. Is anyone with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人が一人います。友人にも柵の向こうへ行かず現在地で合流するよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行友人へ柵外移動回避と現位置合流を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: One friend. I will tell them not to go beyond the fence and to meet me where I am now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your accompanying friend to avoid going beyond the fence and meet at your current location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。確認した経路で案内された場所へ移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please use the confirmed route to the place you are directed to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 不明の小屋へ入らず、友人と合流して確認された雨宿り場所へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明小屋未入場で友人合流後確認済み休憩所へ進むと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not enter the unidentified hut. After meeting my friend, I will head to the confirmed place to shelter from the rain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will not enter the unconfirmed hut and will meet your friend before proceeding to the confirmed rest area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が経路をご案内します。足元にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The person in charge will show you the route. Please watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の所へ行きたいですが、送られた地図の点が動いています。これが待合わせ駅だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 動く友人位置を待合せ駅と誤認して移動先を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to my friend, but the dot on the map they sent is moving. I thought it was the station where we were meeting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook your friend's moving location for the meeting station and ask where to go. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは友人の現在位置の共有でしょうか。固定の駅名も届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could that be your friend's shared current location? Have they also sent a fixed station name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 現在位置と書いてあります。駅名はまだなく、点が進む方向の駅へ行こうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在位置表示のみで駅名未受領・点方向駅へ行く案を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says 'current location.' There is no station name yet, and I was going to head to a station in the direction the dot is moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only have a current-location display, no station name yet, and had planned to go to a station in the dot's direction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 移動中の位置と、待合わせ場所を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check their moving location separately from the meeting place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人へ待合わせる駅名と出口を送ってもらいます。動く点を追う経路は選びません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 固定駅出口を友人へ照会し移動点追跡経路は選ばないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my friend to send the name of the station and exit where we will meet. I will not choose a route that follows the moving dot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask your friend for a fixed station and exit and will not choose a route following the moving dot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご友人も列車で移動中かもしれません。確認できた内容でご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your friend may also be traveling by train. We can guide you based on confirmed information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ列車内なのかは分かりません。位置が動くことだけを、友人の返事と分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人列車乗車は未確認で位置移動観察と本人返答を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not know yet whether they are on a train. I will explain only that I can see the location moving, separately from my friend's reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend's train travel is unconfirmed and distinguish the observed moving location from their own reply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。固定の待合わせ先が決まってからお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please let us know after a fixed meeting place has been decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は切符を買わず、友人へ待合わせ地点を聞きます。現在位置を目的地として決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未購入で待合地点照会し現在位置を目的地と決めないと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not buy a ticket now. I will ask my friend about the meeting point. I will not decide that their current location is my destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you have not bought a ticket, will ask about the meeting point, and will not set the current location as your destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。場所が決まりましたらお声がけください。こちらで経路を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please speak to us when the place is decided. We can check the route here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から証明書を受け取ってほしいと頼まれました。ついでに記載項目を増やしてもよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人証明書代理受取依頼に便宜項目追加可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend asked me to collect a certificate. I would like to check whether I may add more items to it while I am here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may add items for convenience when collecting your friend's certificate on their behalf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 友人からは受取以外の変更も頼まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has your friend asked you to make any changes besides collecting it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。受取だけです。私が多い方が便利だと思って増やそうとしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 依頼受取限定で追加は本人希望未確認の自己案と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, just to collect it. I thought having more items would be convenient, so I was going to add them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the request covers collection only and adding items was your own idea without confirming your friend's wishes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取の依頼と申請内容の変更は分けてください。代理受取の条件も担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish a request to collect it from a change to the application details. The person in charge will also check the conditions for collection by a representative.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人に黙って項目を追加せず、まず本人へ希望を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人へ追加希望照会し無断変更しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not add items without telling my friend. I will first check what they want.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the applicant whether they want additions and will not make changes without permission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人の意思が確認できても、変更の方法は窓口で確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even if their wishes are confirmed, you still need to check the procedure for changes at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人の返事だけで私が変更できるとは決めず、必要な手続きを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人返事だけで代理変更可とせず窓口手続き確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume their reply alone lets me make changes. I will ask about the necessary procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the counter procedure, without assuming the applicant's reply alone authorizes you to make changes as a representative. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。お持ちの依頼資料を担当へ示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please show the person in charge the documents you have for the request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受取だけの依頼として資料を見せ、項目追加は本人の希望と窓口の方法を別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取依頼資料提示と項目追加意思・方法別確認を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the documents as a request for collection only, and check my friend's wishes about extra items separately from the counter's procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will show the collection-request documents and check the wishes about adding items and the procedure separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。証明書担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the certificate desk. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約の連絡を家族にも知らせたいです。でも説明の全部を家族へ任せるのではありません。連絡先を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約連絡の家族共有希望と説明全面委任ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like my family to receive appointment notifications too. But I am not putting them in charge of receiving all explanations. Could I discuss the contact details?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want appointment notifications shared with family but are not delegating all explanations to them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人への連絡と、家族への共有を分けて確認します。どの情報を共有したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check contact with you separately from sharing information with your family. What information would you like shared?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約の日時と変更の連絡です。検査結果の説明まで全部知らせてほしいとは言っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共有範囲を予約日時変更に限定し検査結果全面開示は希望していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The appointment date and time and notifications of changes. I am not asking for everything, including explanations of test results, to be disclosed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that sharing is limited to appointment dates, times and changes, and you are not requesting full disclosure of test results. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 共有できる内容や確認方法を担当へ聞きましょう。ご本人の番号は引き続き使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us ask the person in charge what can be shared and how to confirm it. Can we still use your own number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、使えます。私の番号を消さず、家族の番号を補助の連絡先として相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人番号使用可能で保持し家族番号を補助先として相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I would like to keep my number and discuss adding my family's number as a supplementary contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your own number remains usable and should be retained, and discuss your family's number as a supplementary contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 希望を担当へ伝えます。必ず二人へ同時に連絡できるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass on your wishes. We may not always be able to contact both of you at the same time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族にも連絡してよい範囲を話してあります。家族の番号はこの紙です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族と共有範囲相談済で補助番号を紙で提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I have also discussed with my family what information may be shared. Their number is on this paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have discussed the scope of sharing with your family and present the supplementary number on paper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 番号と希望する範囲を確認します。説明の時にはご本人の希望を改めて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the number and the scope you want. When explanations are given, we will ask your wishes again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日時と変更を共有したいと記録し、その他は別に確認してください。本人の連絡先も残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日時変更共有とその他別確認及び本人連絡先保持を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please record that I want dates, times and changes shared, and check anything else separately. Please keep my own contact details too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for appointment dates, times and changes to be shared, other information to be checked separately, and your own contact details to be retained. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will connect you with the person in charge.
